models.SMA65: previous completed close > SMA65; otherwise cash
models.EMA10_20: previous completed EMA10 > EMA20; otherwise cash; inspired by published product, not replica
models.Donchian55_20_ATR: close > preceding 55 highs enters; close < preceding 20 lows exits; initial 2.5*ATR20 stop, prior-close peak-3*ATR20 trailing; daily-close adaptation
models.SMA65_VOL20: SMA65 signal times min(1, .20/annualized stdev of prior 20 daily returns)
models.ENSEMBLE_VOL20: mean of close>SMA20,65,150 signals times same VOL20 scaler

allocation: Four independent equal initial cash sleeves, no transfers, aggregate equity; fixed survivors only
execution: prior completed daily signal; next daily opening price plus side-specific cost; sells before buys; no leverage or shorts; cash interest zero
vol_rebalance: daily within independent sleeve; trade below minimum skipped
intraday_stops: Donchian model only, prior-day stop; gap uses worse opening price; daily low touches use stop minus sell slippage; not a fill guarantee
benchmarks: equal initial four coin buy and hold
selection_rule: Report all fixed models and both cost scenarios, not only the winner; no retuning after results
limits: No historical orderbook or capacity proof
No promise of future returns or drawdown bounds
